name: dsh-preset-zombie-guard
description: Preset-zombie guard for DeepSeek Harness: periodically scans session logs (zstd frame decoding) for sessions whose effective agent preset no longer exists in the roster; auto-archives blank zombies via the official workspaceRegistry API and deduplicates warnings for non-blank ones. Ships preset_guard_check_remove (full-decode dependency audit to run before deleting any user preset) and preset_guard_last_report. Born from the 2026-08-31 preset-deletion incident. 预设僵尸守护：周期扫描会话日志识别失效预设引用；空白僵尸自动归档，非空白告警去重；删除预设前的依赖安全检查。
